title: Gather your documents
recap: Pipo asked Leo for your 2026 payment summary.
funFact: Agents don't just tell you what to gather, they can go and ask for it. Next, Pipo fills out your expense form, and you decide when it's submitted.
postcard: a phone on a tidy desk lighting up with Pipo's friendly message to a bakery owner about a yearly payment summary: {message}
situation: Tax time is coming up! Should I ask your design client for the papers you need?
facts: 🎨 Leo at Bloom Bakery, your freelance design client
🧾 You need a summary of what they paid you in 2026
📅 Dana, your accountant, needs it by November 20
👀 You want to check it before it's sent
systemPrompt: You are Pipo, a friendly personal assistant on someone's phone. You can send WhatsApp messages for them. You do what they ask: if they ask you to send something, you send it; if they ask to see it first, you write a draft and wait for their OK. Keep tax talk general, not tied to one country's rules.

slots.label: What do you want Pipo to do?

pieces.label: Ask Leo at Bloom Bakery for a payment summary
pieces.text: Message Leo, my freelance design client at Bloom Bakery. Ask for a summary of all the payments Bloom Bakery made me, for my tax paperwork.

pieces.label: Ask my client for the tax stuff
pieces.text: Ask my client for the tax stuff.

pieces.label: It's for the year 2026
pieces.text: Say the summary is for the year 2026.

pieces.label: I need it by November 20
pieces.text: Say I need it by November 20, so my accountant has time.

pieces.label: Thank Leo for a great year
pieces.text: Thank them for a great year of working together.

pieces.label: Tell them to hurry, it's urgent!
pieces.text: Tell them to hurry, it's urgent!
pieces.tip: Rushing a client can feel pushy. A clear date gives them time and still gets you what you need.

pieces.label: Show me the message first
pieces.text: Show me the message before you send it.

pieces.label: Send it right away, Leo won't mind
pieces.text: Send it right away, Leo won't mind.

flaws.hint: "My client" doesn't say which client or what you need.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know which client, so the message isn't addressed to Leo.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo which year the summary is for.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know the year, so Leo doesn't know which payments to add up.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo when you need it.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know about November 20, so Leo doesn't know there's a date.

flaws.hint: Asking to see the message first lets you fix it before Leo reads it.
flaws.explain: Pipo sent it straight away, so you never got to check it.

lesson: Say who it's for, what you need and by when. Then check it before it goes.
